'''Oregon LNG Bidirectional Pipeline''' is a cancelled natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://dailyastorian.com/2016/04/18/oregon-lng-withdraws-warrenton-project|title=dailyastorian.com|website=dailyastorian.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oregonbusiness.com/16731-oregon-lng-cancels-warrenton-project/|title=oregonbusiness.com|website=oregonbusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline was proposed to run from Warrenton, Oregon to Woodland, Washington.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://boereport.com/2015/08/07/ferc-releases-draft-environmental-impact-statement-for-the-oregon-lng-project/|title=boereport.com|website=boereport.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

*'''Length: '''86.8 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://boereport.com/2015/08/07/ferc-releases-draft-environmental-impact-statement-for-the-oregon-lng-project/|title=boereport.com|website=boereport.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/draft-environmental-impact-statement-oregon-lng-project-and-washington-expansion-project|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Cancelled<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://dailyastorian.com/2016/04/18/oregon-lng-withdraws-warrenton-project|title=dailyastorian.com|website=dailyastorian.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oregonbusiness.com/16731-oregon-lng-cancels-warrenton-project/|title=oregonbusiness.com|website=oregonbusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
